scope: Real selection/lifecycle code; terminal states explicitly prepared in controller tests. No art/canon certification.

checks.name: All 460 existing definitions select without altering actors, profiles or RNG
An intermediate round cannot nominate a finisher winner
An already-reported match cannot reopen its conclusion window
Unknown, fractional, negative and string selections do not silently choose slot zero
A foreign profile or copied actor cannot own the current winner presentation
Duration and phase contracts are validated before presentation starts
Early, NaN and infinite ticks cannot validate finisher completion
Cinematic completion uses its own exact scaled duration
A different match, replaced actor, mutation or changed round invalidates the pending sequence
The exact original finisher definition is required for its completion record
The live controller does not credit a started or interrupted conclusion
The live skip button preserves one standard result and no finisher achievement
The live controller credits one completed sequence exactly once, not at startup
Invalid selection keeps the live choice window unchanged and retryable
Pause freezes a pending conclusion without adding progress, then resumes normally
